_doc: Display-time glyph mapping ONLY. The canonical text in content/quran/dist keeps the KFGQPC/QuranEnc code points and is what every integrity hash covers. The bundled Amiri Quran font draws open (idgham) tanween at U+08F0..U+08F2, while the KFGQPC text encodes them at U+0657/U+065E/U+0656. Clients apply this map to the string they hand to the text renderer, never to stored, searched, synced or hashed text. Remove this map once the KFGQPC HAFS font is bundled.
